map.立杆稳定性 K = N / (φ·A·f)（按 JGJ130 轴压稳定）: Standard stability K = N / (φ·A·f) (axial compression stability per JGJ130)
map.按施工荷载、风压、立杆间距与步距校核立杆稳定承载力；K 仅作快速校核，正式设计须: Check standard load capacity from construction load, wind pressure, standard spacing and lift; K is a quick check only — formal design must follow JGJ130 including initial bow and joint looseness
map.💡 N=1.2(Ng1+Ng2)+1.4·Nq；λ=μ·h/i；σ=N/(φA): 💡 N=1.2(Ng1+Ng2)+1.4·Nq; λ=μ·h/i; σ=N/(φA)+Mw/W ≤ f=205MPa; safety factor K=f/σ.
map.钢管 Φ48×3.5：截面积 A=489mm²，截面模量 W=5078mm³，回: Pipe Φ48×3.5: area A=489mm², section modulus W=5078mm³, radius of gyration i=15.8mm, f=205MPa
map.排距取 1.05m，挡风系数 φ≈0.6，脚手板自重 0.35kN/m²，每 2: Row spacing 1.05m, wind-shield coefficient φ≈0.6, plank self-weight 0.35kN/m², one layer per 2 lifts
map.本验算为单立杆稳定简化计算，高大于 50m 需分段卸荷及专业验算: This check is a single-standard simplified stability calc; above 50m needs staged unloading and professional check
map.📚 深度解析：扣件式脚手架立杆稳定性安全验算: 📚 Deep Dive: Coupler-scaffold Standard-stability Safety Check
map.脚手架安全验算：按立杆稳定性公式验算轴力、长细比、稳定系数与安全系数: Scaffold safety check: per standard-stability formula check axial force, slenderness and stability coefficient and safety factor
map.风载校核：计入风弯矩组合应力: Wind-load check: include wind-moment combined stress
map.合格判定：安全系数 K≥1 为安全: Pass/fail: safety factor K≥1 is safe
map.轴力 N=1.2×(立杆自重+构配件重)+1.4×施工荷载；长细比 λ=步距×1: Axial force N=1.2×(standard self-weight+fitting weight)+1.4×construction load; slenderness λ=lift×1000÷radius i (Φ48×3.5 i=15.8mm); stability coefficient φ by λ table interpolation; stress σ=N×1000/(φ×A)+Mw×10⁶/W; safety factor K=fy/σ (fy=205MPa), K≥1 safe.
map.K≥1 表示不考虑缺陷时满足，但实际脚手架含初弯曲、节点松动等，规范另有稳定承载: K≥1 means safe ignoring defects; actual scaffolds have initial bow and loose joints, and the code has a separate stability-capacity formula and construction requirements; K is a quick check only — formal check follows JGJ130.
map.风弯矩什么时候不能忽略？: When can wind moment not be ignored?
map.高脚手架或大风压地区风弯矩显著，本例 Mw 约占总应力 1/3；沿海地区须用正确: For tall scaffolds or high-wind areas wind moment is significant; here Mw is about 1/3 of total stress; coastal areas must use correct basic wind pressure w₀ and consider wind gust.
